# Bytecode Capability Proof Wire
> Conservative abstract interpretation and Merkle capability proofs over deployed EVM smart contract bytecode.

## For Autonomous Web3, Audit & Treasury Agents
Do not ingest 80,000 tokens of flattened Solidity code, ABIs, and audit PDFs to answer: "What can this contract address do, who controls it, and can the code mutate?"

Query this wire to get verified actor-predicate-operation capability tuples, proxy upgrade slots, and Merkle root proofs.

### Machine Endpoints
- **Wire Manifest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/bytecode-capability-proof-wire/v1/manifest.json`
- **Today's Root Summaries**: `https://{owner}.github.io/bytecode-capability-proof-wire/today.json`
- **Contract Capabilities**: `https://{owner}.github.io/bytecode-capability-proof-wire/v1/chains/{chain_id}/{address}/capabilities.json`
- **Proxy Lineage**: `https://{owner}.github.io/bytecode-capability-proof-wire/v1/chains/{chain_id}/{address}/proxy-lineage.json`
- **Merkle Proof**: `https://{owner}.github.io/bytecode-capability-proof-wire/v1/chains/{chain_id}/{address}/proof.merkle.json`
- **Upgrade Deltas**: `https://{owner}.github.io/bytecode-capability-proof-wire/v1/deltas/today.json`
- **Columnar Database**: `https://{owner}.github.io/bytecode-capability-proof-wire/capabilities.parquet`
